decision: Record CC BY-SA 4.0 in place of the CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 declared in the Lexibank CLDF metadata.

evidence.from: Theraphan Luangthongkum (author of the source publication), private e-mail to Tiago Tresoldi
evidence.text: Yes, Tiago, and the dataset in Lexibank has the wrong license -- in fact, if you look at the source on JSEALS you can see it is just CC-BY-SA
evidence.note: Answer to Tiago Tresoldi's question about the license of the Lexibank dataset; the author also approved the correction to be made upstream in the next Lexibank release.

evidence.publication: Luangthongkum, Theraphan (2019). A View on Proto-Karen Phonology and Lexicon. Journal of the Southeast Asian Linguistics Society 12.1: i-lii.
evidence.notice_text: Copyright vested in the author; Creative Commons Attribution Licence

assessment: Both statements exclude NonCommercial and NoDerivatives, so the upstream CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 declaration is an error. The journal notice reads as CC BY without ShareAlike; the author's statement says CC BY-SA. Arca records the more restrictive CC BY-SA 4.0 until the upstream release states the license explicitly.
